info.title: Yield Guardian
info.description:
Yield Guardian API: semiconductor yield investigation on real fab data (SECOM, WM-811K).

* Errors are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` (schema `Problem`).
* Investigator events stream as server-sent events (schema `InvestigationEvent`).
* The live line streams on the WebSocket `/ws/line` as JSON text frames (schema `LineEvent`).
* Actions need a session cookie and the `X-CSRF-Token` header (see `/session`).

Readiness: bundles verified, database reachable, services loaded.
The measured-results table. A row's estimate is null until it is measured on held-out data.
Plant clock, the latest units, counts and open alarms. Live updates: WebSocket /ws/line.
Units in time order, up to the plant clock.

`position = floor((now - epoch) / seconds_per_unit) mod units_total`; `cycle` counts completed
replays. Units after `position` have not come off the line yet and are never returned.
